sourceCaveats: Filter on page20 is a category heading, visually verified and confirmed by14pt Serato-Black font versus9pt individual effect names. It does not specify the local manifest Filter algorithm.
Page20 literally prints TITLE for a tiling description; association with local Tile is probable, not exact-label proof.
Page21 repeats vertical-axis wording for Spin H and Spin V. Preserve ambiguity rather than silently correcting the manual.

Posterize says three colors; global palette versus per-channel levels and exact palette are not resolved by that sentence. Current2..16 levels/channel is materially different from a literal three-color result.
Box Both alternation event/cadence and Scratch threshold/hysteresis are unspecified. Proposed deterministic choices must remain labeled independent.
Absence from these pages does not prove absence from2015 software or installed4.0.10.
Broadly consistent means no concrete contradiction found in short prose, never reference parity.

Existing72/72 FX and51/51 transition tests validate prior independent contracts; some explicitly encode semantics contradicted here (Frame Pulse hold, Gamma brighten, snapshot latches). Do not relabel them manual acceptance.
